_about: INVENTED DATA for a book example. Stands in for an MLR-approved claims library and label summary. Brands Zentivra and Lumotrex are fictional. The rules are simplified keyword rules for teaching, not a real compliance standard.

Zentivra.approved_indication: Treatment of chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) in adults.

approved_content.text: In the pivotal trial, Zentivra reduced the risk of heart failure hospitalization versus placebo. See full Prescribing Information.
Zentivra is taken once daily. Titrate per the Prescribing Information based on tolerability and renal function.

Lumotrex.approved_indication: Maintenance treatment of moderate to severe asthma in adults.

approved_content.text: Lumotrex improved lung function at week 12 versus placebo in adults with moderate to severe asthma. See full Prescribing Information.

rules.description: Mentions a patient population outside the approved label (both brands are approved for adults only).
Uses absolute or guarantee language that no label supports.
Claims superiority over another product without head-to-head data in the label.
